text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
“—Hello there! I love sports, and shining 
sweat connects the world!”

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Your thrilling athletic UmaTuber, Sonon 
Elfie, here!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, let's get right into it today as 
well!! U.A.F. Athlete Memory!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"'Introducing today's highlights is this 
athlete Umamusume right here! Please take 
it away!'"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Hello~ Nice to meet you. ...Man, this 
really makes me nervous."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha! You can relax your shoulders, you 
know!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"I'd like to have a quick chat first... 
Oh, should we talk while we train?"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Ah~, that might actually be better. 
Moving my body helps calm me down anyway."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"—You used to race on the regional 
circuit, didn't you!"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I managed to make it all the way to 
competing in graded races~. But I just 
couldn't pull off a win."

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I was really confident in my power, you 
know. But well, you can't win races on 
strength alone, right? I ended up hitting 
my limit."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"‘But from there, she boldly switched to 
MMA! I watched her last match too~! It was 
super cool!!’"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much. It's not widely 
recognized in Japan yet, but... someday, I 
want to become an athlete who represents 
our country."

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"A lot of athletes compete in the U.A.F. 
for sports that aren't widely known for 
Umamusume to participate in yet, right?"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Pushing the limits of physical ability 
against Umamusume like that... is really 
fun. It really broadens your horizons as 
an athlete."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"I totally, ABSOLUTELY get it!!! It is 
truly the miracle of glistening sweat!!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"And now, it's finally time for the 
highlights! The one you've chosen is...—"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“I went with that graded race we talked 
about earlier. The race where I 
was............ closest to winning.”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“――――They draw level on the home stretch!! 
Can she find more speed!? The leader is 
holding on bravely!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"‘It's a two-horse battle now! They're 
pulling away from the pack! Will it be the 
inside, or the outside?! The inside or the 
outside—!!’"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Across the line!! Emerging victorious 
from this fierce battle is—"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... It's frustrating no matter how 
many times I watch this. But at the same 
time, I feel like I gave it everything I 
had."

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Giving it my all at that moment, and 
still losing— for me, that became the 
energy I needed to move forward to the 
next stage."

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely because you gave it your all, 
don't look back—keep moving forward. Take 
on new challenges! Something like that, 
you know?"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to that, I was able to dive 
headfirst into the world of MMA without 
fear—and I believe it's what led to where 
I am today."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "...I understand completely!"

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer A
text_block_list.text:
"—Wait, the girl who was racing on the 
local circuit...! I knew it! It really is 
that girl I used to cheer for...!"

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer A
text_block_list.text:
She was in the U.A.F....! And now she's 
doing mixed martial arts? That's 
awesome...! Man, takes me back...—

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer A
text_block_list.text:
...... Maybe I'll watch the 『U.A.F.』. 
It's been a while, I really want to cheer 
this girl on...!

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"—Elfie, you used to be at Tracen Academy, 
right? To tell you the truth, so was I."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "Wait, really!?"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Well, we're from slightly different 
generations. I still gave it my all at the 
mile back then, you know. Placing in a GⅠ 
is my pride and joy!"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Well yeah, but that race where I placed 
on the board was the one I retired on... 
Due to injury, you know."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"And after that, you entered the world of 
parkour?"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Yep. Saw it on TV while I was doing 
rehab, and thought, 'Whoa, that looks so 
cool!'"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I felt like I had accomplished everything 
in racing, so I decided to try something 
new—and hup!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "Oooohh! What incredible agility!!"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Heheh. Right~?!"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"—My top highlight is this! My very own 
retirement race!"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"It brings back bitter memories too, but 
still, I think that was when I shone the 
brightest. ...Will you watch it?"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "Why, of course!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Now, entering the final straight in a 
tight pack!! Who will break away from 
here?!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Tangled together across the line!! What 
an unbelievable race!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Oh-no!? An Umamusume is clutching her leg 
and going down! The fallen runner is—"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...Honestly, the moment I got injured, it 
felt like the end of the world. Everything 
just went black before my eyes—"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"But after getting treated... and being 
lucky enough to move my legs again, it 
made me realize: you really never know 
what life has in store for you."

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"‘That's why... I want to cherish the 
present! I want to prioritize what I feel 
in the moment above all else!’"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Choosing parkour was the same thing. I 
held on to that feeling of how cool it was 
in that moment, and that's how I ended up 
here."

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm totally enjoying the moment right 
now. And I love that about myself."

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to prove it at the U.A.F. That 
the me right now is way livelier and way 
cooler than I used to be!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "It's wonderful...! Truly...!"

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer B
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey! The girl on Elfi's stream right 
now! Isn't she the one you used to root 
for!?”

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer C
text_block_list.text: “No way— Huh... it really is her...!!”

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer C
text_block_list.text:
Ah... she looks so lively...!! I see, 
she's participating in the U.A.F....!! I 
see...!!

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer B
text_block_list.text:
"Talk about destined. We've got no choice 
but to cheer for her!"

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! I have to let my old fan-friends 
know too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One day, topics about the U.A.F. started 
popping up on social media far more 
frequently than before.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
“—I came here today to express my 
gratitude to all the Trainers once again.”

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"This project was conceived only because 
of the words the two of you shared. 
...Thank you so very much."

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
I only shared a few of my memories, but if 
it helped the tournament, then I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's a great feature. The 'U.A.F. 
Athlete Memory.'"

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the past and present of these 
athlete Umamusume connected like this... 
really makes me want to cheer for them.
choice_data_list:
I'm so glad I got to feel closer to the 
racers!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: I am honored.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
……Every single competitor has their own 
story, and every person cheering them on 
has a story of their own as well.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: In that moment, "we" were truly connected.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Even if that connection... should 
temporarily become clouded—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
If there's a new stage to shine on, I know 
we'll be able to connect again.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The U.A.F. is a stage that unlocks new 
possibilities for entertainment, and—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
And that it should once again be a place 
where the stories of the athletes and 
those cheering them on intertwine and 
connect—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, I realized it. ...And that I can do 
it, too.”

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, I focused solely on promoting 
the overarching tournament itself—"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I intend to make up for my mistakes up to 
today by making the U.A.F. an even greater 
success.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to it. I will continue 
to cooperate with you.
choice_data_list: I'll do my best together with <chrname> too!
I'll do my best together with <chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to continuing to work with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
――Now then, maybe I'll grab dinner 
somewhere before heading back to the 
office...

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: —Ryouka-saaaaan!!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Elfie...! Weren't you supposed to be at 
university today—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I dashed straight here the moment my 
lecture finished! Since Tracen Academy is 
pretty close by, I figured I'd make it in 
time!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Let's eat! Food!! We haven't been able to 
eat together lately, have we?!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. Since you took the 
trouble to come all this way, shall we get 
going?"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Elfie.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
It's going to get busy again. Let's keep 
giving it our all for the U.A.F.!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!!
